messages.subject: MathJax not interpreted
parts:
I'm facing an issue when trying to include in my shiny app a markdown file which contains MathJax expressions.

in my UI.R I'm using `includeMarkdown()` to import the markdown file


```
includeMarkdown("test.md")
```

In the markdown file, I've added the following snippet to import the MathJax.js library.

```
<script type="text/javascript"
  src="http://cdn.mathjax.org/mathjax/latest/MathJax.js?config=TeX-AMS-MML_HTMLorMML">
</script>
```

In my machine, MathJax is correctly interpreted and displayed, but in shinyapps.io, the MathJax formulas are not interpreted, i.e., I see the MathJax expressions in the text like this:

```
\(S=w_{1}, w_{2},\ldots,w_{k}\)
```

I also tried to add the MathJax.js to the `www/`folder of my app, and import it from there directly, just in case that shinyapps.io is not allowing external connections from their servers, are you actually doing this? Anyway, this neither worked.
 
Is this a known issue? Is there something I'm missing? Thanks in advance

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] MathJax not interpreted
parts:
http resources won't work on ShinyApps.io; you should use https, or
just use withMathJax() anywhere in ui.R:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/mathjax.html

Regards,
Yihui
